theme: BAWIPA KOEHNA - AMAH MINGKHUUEPNA

lines: A lungna caboei dawngah,
Takawi oen boengloeng n'huh u;

Adam rang oen n'sung u te;
Athi a laawngsak rang oen,
Pathen mami kah soeprep;
Te tahaam dawngah hingna,
Ngaimawngna, tlangna, n'huh u;

Pathen boengloeng becoeih pawk;
Vaan thaihu awmngaih oen n'teng,
Te boengloeng Pathen muime;
Lungna oen boengloeng n'awk u,
Bawipa Nang kan ming khuep u;
Bawipa dawng kan tuhkai u,
Kalvari kah na bibi.

title: Ral tuk ham Capa hai la cet,
first_line: Ral tuk ham Capa hai la cet,
theme: Wēnyi mӑsa mӑjan poi--- Mӑdu Kӑrai a wan leng hta

lines: Ral tuk ham Capa hai la cet,
Sengp'hrang lumuek dang ham;
Thisen samtoe thlaa kalawng tueng,
U cangna hu ka vai?;
Youthee boengloeng ka aw thaikung,
Tlawhnatna ka taa thai;
Thinglam uehna ka khuen thaikung,
Bawipa lawng a vai thai.
Duek lamha, langta mik ka khueh,
Khat ben ral pheng ka hu;
Vaan kah a Bawipa aka hu,
Thlawn ham Bawipa a khue;
Thawlh ngai thoemna kawng a thui pe,
Tlawhnat duekna tiim ah;
Tethli kah sai thawlh ham thangthui,
Cangna ka vaithli ham.
A bawilenna a tuek thlaang yawl,
Tethli saw Muithla law;
Hubang thlaihih lawng lamtoen u,
Nuih bu, ungna thinglam;
Thlaang ngawn thlaanghuenthli oen hum u,
Bawilen mingthangna mui;
Duek hamthli lawngah ba kuuep u,
U cangna ka vai ai?.
Sawsang ralkap patawng camaw,
Im khuehkung sibawi nu;
Thlawnkung kah ngawlhcoen awmngaih u,
A himbaai ang rawngtheng;
Saw ben vaan kah tharaana oen,
Patangna a poeng u;
Pathen lawng lungvatna te m'peek,
Cangpuina hu bang ham.

title: Tsaw Mădu a nsen na
first_line: Tsaw Mădu a nsen na
theme: Hpung shingkang myit măda lam – Măgup sumhpa

lines: Tsaw Mădu a nsen na
Yu u, lăwan yu wa
Bum ni hta gum rawt nga let
Bum ntsa hta kăgat nga
Paw pru wa ai kumla ni
Hkrang shăgu hta mu lu
La nnan yu wa săna
Tsaw ra num nnan la
Kăja wa Mădu yu wa
Lăwan yu rit, Mădu
Paw pru wa ai hpe la nga
Hpu htum mungga Amen
Lănyan nnga yu wa rit
Nsim nsa kyu hpyi
Myit nden ja let la nga
Du wa na hkungran poi
Anhte nsen na măyu
Myi man Mădu mu lu
Dwi sau lam hpring nsen ni
Chyeju gălaw myi man
Rawt u, tsawm htap nye tsawra
Mătsun lam hpe mărit
Tsawra ai shi nsen gaw
Rawt nna, pru wa rit
Ginhtawng lădaw mărang lai
Nampan ga ntsa pu
Yēsu a lung mat ai jan
Myit măsin ni bang ya
Măhkawn hkawn na aten nan
Hkru du nsen na lu
Tsawra a yu wa lam hpe
Dwi sau nsen shădut
Ga gwi kăsha rim la ga
Tsăbyi pu jăhten wa
Tsӑbyi ru hpun pu tsawm sai
Mahkra Mădu mătu
Nhtoi htoi lăwan du wa
Nsin ni hprawng tsan de
Mănam pyaw bum hta Mădu
Daini jang yu wa rit
